name: Penske Media Corporation (PMC)
note: DS Penske partner; PMC lists the team among its brands (founder Jay Penske owns the Penske Autosport operation). Left unrated: Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG) invested $200 million in PMC in February 2018 (pmc-srmg-investment); PMC called it minority funding, and neither the size of the stake nor any board seat is published. SRMG's controlling ownership runs through state-linked funds to Saudi Arabia's PIF (srmg-state-ownership), so a stake of 5% or more, or a board seat, would be a link to the Saudi state.
